# ispect

**Tag**: inspector, ispect, debug, toolkit, debug-toolkit, mobile, networking

## 简介

In-app observability and QA diagnostics toolkit for Flutter, with logs, network tracing, layout inspection, exports, and redaction.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/yelmuratoff/ispect
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/yelmuratoff/ispect/issues
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/ispect
